about: Recognizer pipeline golden, written by parity/tools/pipeline-golden/regen.mjs: synthetic line sets through the C++ Recognizer::process() against an empty scene, built with doubles and PI = π. `fixed` has the C1 and C2 fixes (the TS default); `legacy` is the C++ as is (TS with both quirks); `chordCost` is `fixed` with the chord-distance LineAggregator::getCost (see regen.mjs).
